summary: NeuroSense Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-20 reverse share split of its no-par ordinary shares, consolidating 37,938,036 shares into roughly 1,896,902, effective with Nasdaq Capital Market trading beginning September 14, 2026. Authorized capital is unchanged; fractional shares round up, and warrant/option exercise prices and share counts adjust proportionately. New CUSIP is M74240207. The filing is incorporated by reference into the registrant's Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms are stated. Watch for post-split trading volatility, liquidity, and potential Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance implications.
